# Responses

Every response is a JSON object that starts with the same envelope:

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `api_version` | string | The API version that produced the response, e.g. `"1"`. |
| `deprecated` | boolean | false on the current version. true on a replaced, frozen version (it then also has `deprecation`). |
| `school` | string | School id, e.g. `queens`. |
| `data_as_of` | string (ISO 8601) or null | When the newest source in this response was collected. |
| `endpoint` | string | Which endpoint answered: `all`, `item`, `filter`, `tag`, `tags`, `info`, `schools` or `index`. |

`schools.json` and `index.json` cover all schools, so they have no `school` key.

On a **deprecated** version, every response also has:

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `deprecation.since` | string (date) | When this version was deprecated. |
| `deprecation.successor` | string | The version to move to, e.g. `v2`. |
| `deprecation.successor_index` | string | Endpoint guide of the successor, e.g. `v2/index.json`. |
| `deprecation.sunset` | string (date) or null | Date this version may be removed. null means no date has been set. |
| `deprecation.data_frozen_at` | string or null | When this version's data was last updated. It no longer changes. |
| `deprecation.message` | string | A human-readable explanation. |

See [versions.md](versions.md).

## Keys after the envelope, by endpoint


### `all`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | Number of activities. |
| `items` | array of activities | Every activity at the school. |

### `item`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `item` | activity | The activity. |

### `filter`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | object | The five filter segments you asked for, echoed back. |
| `count` | integer | Number of matches. |
| `items` | array of activities | The matches. |

### `tag`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `query` | object | `{"tag": "<tag>"}`. |
| `count` | integer | Number of matches. |
| `items` | array of activities | Activities with the tag. |

### `tags`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | Number of distinct tags. |
| `tags` | object | Tag → number of activities with it. |

### `info`

| Key | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `school_info` | object | School name and location. |
| `count` | integer | Number of activities. |
| `faculties` | object | Faculty id → name, description, sources, subfaculties, item count and its filter URL. |
| `sources` | array | Each directory: id, name, url, fetched_at, via (`live` or `wayback`), items, archived_at. |
| `filters` | object | For each filter segment: valid values, counts and meanings. `subfaculty.by_faculty` lists the sub- values valid under each faculty. |
| `endpoints` | object | Every endpoint with its path, what it returns and an example. |
| `numeric_fields` | object | Numeric item fields for client-side filtering. |
| `filter_files` | integer | How many filter combinations exist. |

An "activity" is the object described in [fields.md](fields.md).
